rubric.description: (a) Counts occurrences of each value (for example with a nested loop)
(a) Keeps track of the value with the greatest count
(a) Resolves a tie by choosing the smaller value
(b) Creates a new array of the same length and does not modify `a`
(b) Computes the source index for each position with correct wraparound (for example `(i + k) % n`)
(b) Handles `k` larger than `a.length` and returns the new array
(a) Traverses the array comparing each element with the previous one without going out of bounds
(a) Maintains the length of the current plateau, resetting to 1 when a different value occurs
(a) Tracks and returns the longest length (0 for an empty array)
(b) Traverses the array and moves each nonzero value forward to the next open position, preserving order
(b) Does not overwrite a nonzero value before it has been copied
(b) Fills the remaining positions with zeros
(b) Modifies the array in place without creating another array
